GOAP is an important advance for all-atom, orientation-dependent potentials for protein structure prediction, and is a promising advance for all- atom, distance- and orientation-dependent statistical potentials for protein structure and function prediction.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the orientation-dependent, all atom statistical potential, GOAP, is a significant improvement over previous all atom potentials, such as the distance-dependent, all atom DFIRE, and the orientation-dependent, side chain atom contact potential, OPUS-PSP.
GOAP is a new, accurate all-atom, distance- and orientation-dependent, knowledge-based potential that can be used for protein structure prediction and refinement.
the orientation-dependent, all atom statistical potential GOAP is a major advance for knowledge-based, all atom statistical potentials.

orientation-dependent, all atom contact potential is important for protein structure prediction.

a knowledge-based potential can be made more accurate if it is orientation-dependent, and that an all-atom statistical knowledge-based potential can outperform a side-chain atom contact knowledge-based potential.
